Commentary.Commentary: Back for the chase! Wesley Madhevere and Tarisai Musakanda will open for Zimbabwe. Mohammad Hasnain will use the new ball.

Can Zimbabwe chase it down? The pitch is looking good but they come up against the strong Pakistani bowling lineup. It will be interesting to see how they plan the chase. Do join us for the second innings in a bit!

Zimbabwe were poor with the ball. They picked up the early wicket but couldn't pick up another till the last over. Luke Jongwe continued to impress and picked up all the 3 wickets. Wellington Masakadza was economical but did not pick any wickets. The rest of the bowlers had a day to forget.

Pakistan lost Sharjeel Khan early but Mohammad Rizwan and Babar Azam steadied their ship. They both put on a terrific partnership and got to their fifties. They both started off slow and exploded towards the end. In the end, they get to 165 and will be happy with that.
End of a brilliant performance by Pakistan. They paced the innings to perfection and will be very happy with the score. It was a disappointing day for the Zimbabwe bowlers.
Slower length ball, around off. Mohammad Rizwan taps it to long on for a couple. PAKISTAN GET TO 165 FOR 3!
Hasan Ali is the new man in.
Length ball, on the stumps. Rizwan clips it past mid-wicket and sprints back for the second.
OUT! TAKEN! Jongwe is on a hat trick! Fuller ball, outside off. Zaman doesn't get hold of it and ends up chipping it towards long off. Ryan Burl takes a good low catch there.
Is that a catch?
Who will come out now? Fakhar Zaman it is.
OUT! TAKEN! End of a great innings by Azam and Jongwe is the man who takes the wicket! Slower length ball, on the stumps. Babar Azam ends up toe ending it to Ryan Burl at long on.

All set to go! Sharjeel Khan and Mohammad Rizwan will open for Pakistan. Blessing Muzarabani will start with the ball.

Sean Williams, the Zimbabwe skipper, says that is a good opportunity for them to win the series. Adds that they did the basics right in the second game and that helped. Tells that he was going to bowl if he won the toss.

Babar Azam, the Pakistan skipper, he says that the wicket looks dry and they would look to score big. Informs that there are 3 changes in the side. Tells that they have looked to strengthen the batting.

Tino Mawoyo is down for the pitch report, he says that is no grass on the pitch and it is very dry. Adds that seamers might dominate as opposed to spinners. Says that batsmen need to take their time before going big.

Zimbabwe (Playing XI) - Tarisai Musakanda, Wesley Madhevere, Tadiwanashe Marumani, Brendan Taylor, Sean Williams (C) (IN FOR TINASHE KAMUNHUKAMWE), Ryan Burl, Regis Chakabva (WK), Luke Jongwe, Wellington Masakadza, Blessing Muzarabani, Richard Ngarava.

Pakistan (Playing XI) - Mohammad Rizwan (WK), Babar Azam (C), Sharjeel Khan (IN FOR DANISH AZIZ), Fakhar Zaman, Mohammad Hafeez, Sarfaraz Ahmed (IN FOR ASIF ALI), Faheem Ashraf, Hasan Ali (IN FOR ARSHAD IQBAL), Usman Qadir, Haris Rauf, Mohammad Hasnain.
TOSS - Pakistan have won the toss and they will bat first.

It is time for the series decider between Zimbabwe and Pakistan! The hosts bounced back strongly and beat Pakistan in the second T20I, but can they repeat it and win the series? Pakistan on the other hand would look to forget the last game and approach this with a positive mindset. We'll see what happens! With that, a warm welcome to the 3rd T20I between Pakistan and Zimbabwe. Stay tuned for toss and team updates....
